puzzle.comment: Name: Broken Sticks Designed by: Stewart Coffin This puzzle shows off the rhombic grid. It uses colour to show the pieces that were added to the base pieces of the Four Corner Puzzle. Allso note that the result shape is there twice. One is the mirror of the other. There is really no difference except for the shape of the ends of the sticks. They can not be cut completely rectangular that is why there are 2 possible ways and only one has a solution.
